valuelab.detail.check1: Position size: start small (for example 1%-3% of bankroll), add only after validation.
valuelab.detail.check2: Recheck trigger: if market probability moves beyond model band, pause and reassess.
valuelab.detail.check3: Execution rule: avoid all-in entries; use staged entries and predefined exit points.
valuelab.detail.decisionTitle: What Should A Beginner Do Now?
valuelab.detail.digestAvoid: Model fair value sits below current pricing by {edge}. Risk-reward is currently unfavorable for new entries.
valuelab.detail.digestObserve: Market pricing and model fair value are close ({edge}). The edge is thin, so patience and selective timing matter more than speed.
valuelab.detail.digestStrong: Current pricing appears to discount this event too much. Model fair value is above market by {edge}, creating a meaningful but still risky entry window.
valuelab.detail.digestWatch: There is a modest valuation gap of {edge}. This is a watchlist-quality setup: interesting, but not a high-conviction all-in signal.
valuelab.detail.disclaimer: This analysis is for research only and does not constitute investment advice.
valuelab.detail.marketsNote: This event has multiple outcome tiers. Each card shows a specific market and its current implied probability.
valuelab.detail.risk1Text: Any model can fail during regime shifts. Keep a fixed risk budget per position.
valuelab.detail.risk2Text: Thin liquidity can amplify slippage and reduce realized edge.
valuelab.detail.risk3Text: Unexpected news can invalidate the thesis before your next review cycle.
valuelab.detail.scenarioBaseText: Most likely path under current data. Use this as primary anchor for position sizing.
valuelab.detail.scenarioBearText: If risk events hit, fair value can move lower. Keep this scenario in mind for stop decisions.
valuelab.detail.scenarioBullText: If supportive catalysts continue, probability may drift toward the upper bound and reward early scaled entries.
valuelab.detail.title: Value Lab Analysis
valuelab.detail.whyIntro: We compare current market pricing with model fair value, then convert that gap into beginner-friendly action guidance.
valuelab.subtitle: Multi-dimensional valuation framework for crypto and macro prediction events.
